messages.subject: Davis R Users' Group (D-RUG) meeting tomorrow: open work time!
parts:
Hi all, 

This is your weekly reminder of tomorrow's R Users Group work group. As usual, we'll be meeting from 10-noon on Wednesdays. We don't have a presentation on deck, so we will just have open work time tomorrow. 

We will be meeting in a hybrid format, via zoom, and in the Data Lab classroom (360 Shields Library). If you're attending virtually, please post your questions to the discourse site ahead of time. Info + links below.

Best,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

________________________________________________________________
Please remember to post your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

For those not familiar with D-RUG, the R Users' Group is a weekly working group to get some help with R-specific coding problems. The coordinators are various and sundry coding connoisseurs, ranging from UCD data scientists to grad students on campus. We meet for 2 hours in an open-forum format, so you can treat D-RUG as a communal, co-working environment: come hang out and chat, work on your own, seek help, make friends. Or, a little bit of everything! Check out our website for more information.

We are also seeking presenters! It is nice to mix things up with occasional presentations. In the past, we've had (15- to 45-minute) presentations ranging from data types, to tidyverse tools, to spatial data, to the Google Earth Engine plugin for R. If you would like to hone your teaching, need an excuse to perfect your cRaft, or want to show off a cool R trick you learned, shoot us an email and we can add your presentation to our calendar (see below)! Presentations can be in-person or virtual (and in-person presentations will be streamed for virtual attendees).
